channel.title: RONEN DISPLAY — Industrial TFT LCD Engineering Notes
channel.description: Selection, interface, reliability and supply notes for industrial TFT LCD modules from RONEN DISPLAY (factory-direct manufacturer with our own production base).

item.title: AMOLED vs TFT LCD: How to Choose for Industrial Use
item.description: AMOLED vs TFT LCD compared on contrast, power, color, lifespan, sunlight readability and cost — and why a TFT LCD module is usually the safer choice for industrial products that must run reliably for years.

item.title: LCD Bonding: OCA vs Air Gap vs Optical
item.description: LCD bonding compared: OCA optical bonding vs air-gap assembly vs liquid optical clear adhesive (LOCA). How each affects contrast, sunlight readability, dust, durability and cost — and which to specify for industrial and outdoor displays.

item.title: Low-Power Display: MIP vs E-Paper vs Transflective
item.description: How to choose a low-power display for battery-run devices: MIP (memory-in-pixel), e-paper, and transflective TFT compared on power, sunlight readability, color and refresh — and when a high-brightness or transflective TFT module is the better fit.

item.title: MIP vs E-Paper vs TFT: Low-Power Display Compared
item.description: MIP (memory-in-pixel) vs e-paper vs TFT LCD compared on power, refresh, color and sunlight readability — and how to pick the right low-power display for a battery-run device without guessing.

item.title: Round vs Bar Display: Choosing a Non-Rectangular LCD
item.description: Round vs bar display: how a circular or bar-type LCD changes UI layout, driver integration and enclosure design, and how to choose between them for meters, wearables, audio gear and automotive clusters.

item.title: Transflective vs Reflective LCD: Sunlight Readability Compared
item.description: Transflective vs reflective LCD: how each handles sunlight, power and indoor use, and when a transflective TFT module is the safer choice for industrial products that must be readable indoors and out.

item.title: Edge AI HMI Display: What It Is & How to Specify One
item.description: An edge AI HMI display runs on-device inference at the human-machine interface - vision, voice and sensor fusion without a cloud round-trip. Learn what an edge AI HMI is, where it is used, and how to specify compute, display, interface and thermal budget.

item.title: How an LCD Works: Liquid Crystals, Backlight and TFT Pixels
item.description: How does a liquid crystal display work? A practical walk through backlight, polarisers, TFT pixels and colour filters, and what each layer means when you specify an industrial LCD module.

item.title: Industrial Control HMI Displays: Custom ODM Selection Guide
item.description: A selection guide for industrial control and HMI displays: sizes, interfaces, touch and cover glass, wide-temperature and high-brightness options, and how custom ODM projects are evaluated.

item.title: Kinds of Displays: A Practical Taxonomy for Industrial Buyers
item.description: Kinds of displays explained for industrial buyers: emissive vs transmissive, TN vs IPS vs VA, rectangular vs round and bar formats, interfaces, touch stacks and environmental grades.

item.title: LCD Controller Board Selection: Interfaces, Timing and Firmware
item.description: How to select an LCD controller or adapter board: input and output interfaces, panel timing, driver IC initialisation, backlight power, EMI and firmware, with an engineering checklist.

item.title: LCD Panel Failure Modes: Prevention by Specification
item.description: An engineering view of LCD panel failure modes for industrial projects: pixel defects, mura, backlight ageing, moisture, ESD, flex cracking and bonding voids, and how to qualify them out at specification stage.

item.title: What Is an AMOLED Display? Definition and Trade-offs
item.description: What is an AMOLED display? A plain-language definition of active-matrix organic LED technology, how it differs from a TFT LCD, and the trade-offs that matter in industrial equipment.

item.title: RG-T035GCIA-02 Application Note: Interface & Replacement
item.description: Engineering note on the RG-T035GCIA-02 3.5-inch 480x640 MVA MIPI module: interface, ILI9806E driver guidance, replacement and design-in checks.

item.title: RG-T043BPI-01ND Application Note: Interface & Replacement
item.description: Engineering guide to the RG-T043BPI-01ND 4.3-inch 480x272 TN TFT: RGB 24-bit 40-pin interface, ILI6485 driver, power sequencing, ESD/EMI and second-source notes.

item.title: Sunlight Readable Display: What It Is & How to Specify One
item.description: A sunlight readable display stays legible in bright ambient light: typically 1,000+ nits plus anti-reflective cover glass and optical bonding. Learn how a sunlight readable display differs from a standard monitor and how to specify one.

item.title: China Display Sourcing Checklist for OEM Buyers
item.description: What overseas OEM buyers should check when sourcing display modules from China: factory audits, certificate scope, sample approval stages, logistics and packing, and how to lock supply continuity before volume production.

item.title: Custom TFT LCD Module Manufacturing Explained
item.description: What a custom TFT LCD module actually involves: glass mask and cell tooling, backlight design, cover glass and touch integration, FPC and driver board, and how tooling ownership shapes cost, lead time and supply continuity.

item.title: Display Factory Audit Checklist for Buyers
item.description: What to inspect on a display factory visit: assembly lines and tooling, incoming and outgoing test equipment, traceability records, certificate scope and the questions that reveal whether the site actually makes the module.

item.title: Display Module Sourcing Guide for OEM Teams
item.description: An end-to-end sourcing path for display modules: requirement definition, supplier shortlisting, sample approval, incoming inspection, change control and continuity planning — with the checks at each gate.

item.title: Display Sample Approval Process Before Volume
item.description: How display samples move from engineering build to production-equivalent build, what each stage proves, what the approval document must record, and how to hold later batches against the approved reference.

item.title: How TFT LCD Modules Are Made: A Buyer's View
item.description: How an industrial TFT LCD module is actually built: cell and COG bonding, backlight assembly, cover glass and touch lamination, ageing and reliability screening — and which step decides whether a part can be made again years later.

item.title: How to Choose a TFT LCD Manufacturer
item.description: A selection sequence for OEM buyers: define the operating envelope first, then interface and lifetime, then check tooling ownership, continuity commitment and engineering access before comparing quotations.

item.title: Industrial TFT LCD Manufacturer: How to Verify One
item.description: The checks that separate a real industrial TFT LCD manufacturer from a trading company: tooling ownership, glass-mask control, process certifications, continuity commitments and what to ask before you commit a production programme.

item.title: OEM and ODM Display Manufacturing Explained
item.description: The difference between OEM and ODM display manufacturing, what private tooling and exclusive supply actually buy an OEM, and how to decide which route fits a programme's volume and differentiation needs.

item.title: What a TFT LCD Quotation Should Include
item.description: The fields a comparable TFT LCD quotation must carry: electrical, optical and mechanical specification, volume and schedule, tooling ownership, committed supply period and notice period, trade terms, packing and warranty.

item.title: TFT LCD Supplier Selection Criteria for OEM Buyers
item.description: Weighted criteria for scoring TFT LCD suppliers: supply continuity, tooling control, quality-system scope, engineering support, change-notice discipline and documentation quality — with why continuity outranks unit price.

item.title: TFT LCD Supply Agreement Terms That Matter
item.description: The contract clauses that decide a display programme's risk: committed supply period, end-of-supply notice period, process change notice obligations, quality and warranty scope, tooling ownership and exclusive supply.

item.title: Capacitive Touch Screen: How It Works and Where It's Used
item.description: Explain how a capacitive touch screen works, the difference between surface and projected capacitive, and where PCAP is used in industrial and commercial products.

item.title: LVDS, MIPI DSI & HDMI TFT Modules for Embedded HMI
item.description: Compare LVDS, MIPI DSI and HDMI display interfaces for embedded HMI designs, and learn which module format fits your MCU, enclosure and lifecycle plan.

item.title: Display Interfaces for Haptic Touch in Custom Displays
item.description: Which display interface works best with haptic touch feedback in custom displays — USB, HDMI, LVDS, MIPI DSI and eDP compared for latency, cabling and integration.

item.title: High-Brightness Industrial Monitors: Nits Explained
item.description: What 1000, 1500 and 2000 nits mean for industrial monitors, how to choose brightness for indoor, semi-outdoor and outdoor duty, and the role of bonding and cover glass.

item.title: High-Brightness TFT LCD for Automotive & Avionics
item.description: Design considerations for high-brightness, sunlight-readable TFT LCD modules in automotive dashboards and avionics displays — brightness, contrast, temperature and qualification.

item.title: Industrial Touch Screen Monitors: PCAP Integration for HMI
item.description: How industrial touch screen monitors integrate projected capacitive (PCAP) touch, what cover glass and controller choices matter, and how to specify for gloved or wet operation.

item.title: Medical-Grade TFT LCD: Zero-Pixel-Defect & ISO 13485
item.description: How to evaluate zero-pixel-defect TFT LCD options for medical-grade panels, what ISO 13485 means for display suppliers, and which specifications matter for clinical devices.

item.title: MIPI DSI Display Modules for Compact Designs
item.description: How MIPI DSI display modules work, where they fit in compact embedded products, and what routing, EMC and lifecycle factors to plan before adoption.

item.title: Outdoor Industrial Monitors: Sealing & Readability
item.description: Design factors for outdoor industrial monitors — sunlight readability, ingress sealing, temperature range and lifecycle — for kiosks, transport and field equipment.

item.title: PCAP vs IR Touch: Comparison for Industrial Displays
item.description: Compare projected capacitive (PCAP) and infrared (IR) touch technologies for industrial displays — durability, input method, environment and where each fits.

item.title: Resistive vs Capacitive Touch: Industrial Guide
item.description: Compare resistive and capacitive touch screens for industrial applications — input method, environment, durability, multi-touch and total cost — with a decision checklist.

item.title: RLCD & Reflective Displays: Low-Power Sunlight
item.description: What RLCD (reflective LCD) and reflective display technology offer for sunlight-readable, low-power industrial and wearable applications, and how they compare to transflective and high-brightness TFT.

item.title: Sunlight-Readable TFT Modules for Kiosks & Signage
item.description: How to find sunlight-readable TFT LCD modules with the brightness, sealing and long lifecycle needed for self-service kiosks and digital signage — and what to ask suppliers.

item.title: TFT LCD vs LCD: What the Terms Mean for Buyers
item.description: Clarify what TFT LCD and LCD mean, how a TFT backplane differs from other LCD types, and which matters when specifying an industrial display.

item.title: Transflective LCD Modules for Outdoor Industry
item.description: How transflective LCD modules deliver sunlight-readable, power-efficient displays for outdoor industrial devices, and how to specify brightness, temperature range and sealing.

item.title: UART TFT LCD Modules for Embedded Systems
item.description: What UART TFT LCD modules are, how serial command displays simplify embedded GUI work, and when to choose UART over SPI, RGB or LVDS interfaces.

item.title: USB TFT LCD Modules & ESP32 Prototyping
item.description: How USB TFT LCD modules and ESP32-based setups accelerate display prototyping, what interfaces and drivers to expect, and how to move from breadboard to production.

item.title: What Is a Resistive Touch Screen? How It Works
item.description: Explain how a resistive touch screen works, where it still fits in industrial use, and how it compares with capacitive touch for gloved or stylus input.

item.title: 10.4 Inch TFT LCD Module: How to Choose
item.description: How to choose a 10.4 inch industrial TFT LCD module: 800x600 vs 1024x768, LVDS vs RGB, 350-1000 nits, wide temperature and open cell (FOG) options — with live catalog parts.

item.title: 12.1 Inch Industrial LCD: Open Cell vs Bonded
item.description: Choosing a 12.1 inch industrial LCD module: 1280x800 IPS vs 1024x768 vs 800x600, LVDS, 400-1000 nits, and when to buy open cell (FOG) instead of a bonded module — live catalog parts.

item.title: 15.6 Inch Industrial LCD Module: FHD IPS Guide
item.description: 15.6 inch industrial LCD module guide: three standard 1920x1080 IPS models with LVDS, 850-1000 cd/m², capacitive touch option and -30~+85 °C wide temperature — live catalog parts.

item.title: 21.5 Inch Industrial LCD Module: FHD Wide-Temp
item.description: 21.5 inch industrial LCD module guide: RG-T215BFHA-02, 1920x1080 IPS, 1000 cd/m², dual-channel LVDS, -20~+70 °C standard — plus the 18.5 inch 1500-nit wide-temp sibling.
